evidence: Illustrative requirements, not selected anatomy or measured reef traits. The two slow signal rates have limited Earth analogues; other rates are requirements choices. A resultant stress case of 143 N/m2 is chosen for sensitivity, not a computed storm force on the proposed sail.
limits: A uniform panel hinge lever does not represent a validated wing centre of pressure or a safe hinge design.
Ballast and tissue are interchangeable only if their weight acts through an equivalent geometry; membrane weight distributed along a tall sail need not do so.
A split tether's projected-width ratio is not an updated drag or speed result.
Fluid density and tissue stoichiometry are scenario choices. Tissue chemistry, live fraction, upkeep, construction cost and collection transport are unresolved.
Neither material recovery nor having enough carbon establishes the time or developmental viability of growth.
